Baby Janu,

By the time you read this you're probably on your way to the office, and I just want you to start your day knowing one thing. I am really, really proud of you.

Saturday on Beacon was one of the best days I've had in a long time. The drive up through all those colours, the stairs that kept going, our deep conversations, and you, walking all the way up to the fire tower like it was nothing. That night you texted me "Thanks a lot baby for the very very memorable and beautiful day." This whole thing is my reply.

You told me you love small surprises, so I built you a small one. There's a mountain to climb, a jar full of notes, our songs, a few coupons to scratch, and a heart to hold at the end. Take your time.

You once told me "Aise hi rehna mere dil me." I'm not going anywhere.

Seemab

Beacon Fire Tower · Hudson Highlands · Sat, Oct 31

Climb it with me again.

Everyone else spent Halloween in costumes. We spent it on a mountain. Hold the button and walk us up, one stop at a time. I'm the red one, obviously.

Stop 1 of 6 · The surprise0% of the trail
  1. Locked

    Fri, Oct 30 · 12:40 PM

    The surprise

    I texted you "Tomorrow we are going for a hike." You said "Really? You didnot tell me your this plan." That was the whole point. One or two hours of driving, and biryani on the top, I promised.

  2. Keep climbing

    Fri, Oct 30 · 10:26 PM

    The outfit question

    "Can I wear salwar kameez?" you asked, the night before a hike. 😄 Then you showed up in sneakers and leggings and climbed it like you do this every weekend.

  3. Keep climbing

    The trailhead

    The stairs

    This mountain used to have a railway, the Mount Beacon Incline, running from 1902 to 1975. We did it the hard way, about a thousand feet up in the very first mile. You just kept going.

  4. Keep climbing

    The overlook

    First look at the Hudson

    The river, the bridge, little Beacon town below us. The day before, you had texted "Wanted to go for a long drive with you with this colourful view." One day later we were standing in it.

  5. Keep climbing

    Somewhere in the colours

    Deep conversations

    The part I keep replaying. Walking slow, talking about everything, no rush and no tight schedule. Just the "relaxing and peaceful time" you always say you want. I want that too. With you.

  6. Almost there

    The summit

    The fire tower

    Built in 1931, restored in 2013, and on Halloween 2026 it held the two of us. Orange forest in every direction for miles. We made it all the way to the top.

Summit · 360° view

You did it, Fahriba.

Chase · Running club · Future marathoner

Meri bandi banker hai.

Every weekday you're up early and out the door to Chase. Some days you get there an hour before you even need to. Then you run with your club or hit the gym, come home tired, and still find the energy to ask me if I ate.

I see all of it. I don't say it enough, so I'm putting it here where you can read it every morning: I'm proud of you. Every single day.
